title: A role's filter of FALSE () hides every row of its table, and the related rows
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Customers", COUNTROWS ( Customer ), "Amount", [Sales Amount], "Products", COUNTROWS ( Product ) )

source.quote: You can use the filter, =FALSE(), to deny access to all rows for an entire table.
source.supports: no row of Customer is visible

source.quote: Row filters apply to the specified rows as well as related rows.
source.supports: so no row of Sales is either

derivation: Denied filters Customer with FALSE (): no customer is visible, and none of their sales. COUNTROWS of an empty table and SUM over no rows are BLANK. Product is on the one side of Sales: its two rows stay.
